title: Read an SVM parameter search
description: You trace a scaled support vector classifier through cross-validation and inspect how the search reports its selection.

steps.description: You place StandardScaler before SVC in a Pipeline. The classifier uses the radial basis function kernel and enables probability estimates.
You name the classifier settings through svm__C and svm__gamma. Each list supplies candidate values for the search.

steps.question: Which scoring setting selects the best parameter combination?
steps.answer: scoring="roc_auc" selects by area under the receiver operating characteristic curve. StratifiedKFold supplies the validation splits.

steps.description: You fit the search on X and y, then read best_score_ and best_params_. The recorded output reports a selected score and its parameter dictionary.
